questions.prompt: A Backup vault uses GRS and manages Azure Disk Backup operational snapshots. Does that setting copy those disk snapshots into geo-redundant vault storage?

options.text: Yes, every vault-managed workload is stored in the vault.
options.explanation: Operational disk backup is an exception to this assumption.

options.text: Yes, as soon as the disk has a public IP.
options.explanation: Disks have no such public-IP backup switch.

options.text: No; operational disk snapshots are not copied to vault storage.
options.explanation: Vault redundancy therefore does not apply to that operational tier.

options.text: Yes, if the operator has Owner.
options.explanation: Operator RBAC does not change the backup architecture.
